pullzones.list.title: List Pull Zones
pullzones.list.description: List BunnyCDN pull zones with bounded pagination.

search.description: Search term used to filter pull zones by name.

includeCertificate.description: When true, include certificate details in the response.

pullzones.get.title: Get Pull Zone
pullzones.get.description: Retrieve one BunnyCDN pull zone by ID.

id.description: Pull zone ID.

includeCertificate.description: When true, include certificate details in the response.

pullzones.purge.title: Purge Pull Zone Cache
pullzones.purge.description: Purge BunnyCDN pull-zone cache via POST /pullzone/{id}/purgeCache. Omit cacheTag for a full purge; set cacheTag to purge one tag. A repeat purge is safe. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

id.description: Pull zone ID.

cacheTag.description: Optional cache tag to purge; omit for a full-zone purge.

purged.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the purge with HTTP 204.

storagezones.list.title: List Storage Zones
storagezones.list.description: List BunnyCDN storage zones with bounded pagination. Storage-zone Password credentials are omitted from the result.

includeDeleted.description: When true, include deleted storage zones.

pullzones.addAllowedReferer.title: Add Allowed Referer
pullzones.addAllowedReferer.description: Adds a hostname to the allowed referer list for a pull zone. Use this action to restrict content access by configuring referer-based security. Only requests with a Referer header matching one of the allowed hostnames will be able to access the pull zone content. This helps prevent hotlinking and unauthorized content usage from other websites.

id.description: The ID of the pull zone to which the allowed referer will be added. Use the 'Get Pull Zone List' action to find available pull zone IDs.

Hostname.description: The hostname that will be added as an allowed referer. This restricts content access to requests coming from this specific domain (e.g., 'example.com', 'www.mysite.com').

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

pullzones.addBlockedIp.title: Add Blocked IP
pullzones.addBlockedIp.description: Tool to add an IP address to the blocked list of a pull zone. Use when you need to restrict access from specific IPs to prevent unwanted traffic.

id.description: The ID of the Pull Zone to which the IP will be blocked. Use BUNNYCDN_GET_PULL_ZONE_LIST to get valid IDs.

BlockedIp.description: The IP address that will be blocked from accessing the pull zone. Supports IPv4 and IPv6 formats.

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

pullzones.addBlockedReferer.title: Add Blocked Referer
pullzones.addBlockedReferer.description: Tool to add a blocked referer to a pull zone. Use when you need to prevent specific domains from hotlinking or accessing content from your CDN.

id.description: The ID of the pull zone to which the blocked referer will be added. Use the 'Get Pull Zone List' action to find available pull zone IDs.

Hostname.description: The hostname that will be added as a blocked referer. Requests with this referer will be blocked from accessing the pull zone content.

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

storagezones.add.title: Add Storage Zone
storagezones.add.description: Tool to add a new storage zone. Use when you need dedicated file storage in a specific region. Zone creation is irreversible — confirm Name, Region, and ZoneTier before executing.

Name.description: Name of the storage zone to be created. Must be unique and can contain alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

Region.description: Primary region for the storage zone. Allowed values: DE (Germany), NY (New York), LA (Los Angeles), SG (Singapore).

ZoneTier.description: Storage tier. 0 = Standard (default), 1 = Edge (for edge storage).

OriginUrl.description: Backup data source URL. If a file is missing in the storage zone, BunnyCDN will try to fetch it from this URL.

ReplicationRegions.description: List of additional regions for replicating the storage zone data. Allowed values: DE, NY, LA, SG, SYD (Sydney). Cannot include the primary region.

pullzones.edgeRules.addOrUpdate.title: Add/Update Edge Rule
pullzones.edgeRules.addOrUpdate.description: Tool to add or update edge rules in a BunnyCDN pull zone for advanced traffic control. Edge rules allow conditional request processing based on triggers like URL patterns, headers, country codes, or IP addresses. Each rule can perform actions like forcing SSL, redirecting, setting headers, overriding cache TTL, or blocking requests. Common use cases: - Force HTTPS: ActionType=force_ssl with URL tr

Guid.description: The unique GUID of the edge rule. Provide this to update an existing rule. Leave empty to create a new rule. The API returns this GUID when creating a rule.

Enabled.description: Whether the edge rule is currently active. Set to true to enable the rule immediately, false to create it in disabled state.

ReadOnly.description: Whether the edge rule is read-only and cannot be modified or deleted. Typically used for system-generated rules.

Triggers.description: List of trigger conditions that determine when this edge rule executes. At least one trigger is required. Common use: URL trigger with pattern '/*' matches all requests.

OrderIndex.description: Execution priority order. Lower numbers execute first. Use this to control the sequence of multiple edge rules. If not specified, the rule is added at the end.

Description.description: Human-readable description of what this edge rule does. Helps identify the rule's purpose when managing multiple rules.

ExtraActions.description: Additional actions to execute when the edge rule triggers. Allows combining multiple actions (e.g., set header AND override cache time) in one rule.

pull_zone_id.description: The ID of the Pull Zone where the Edge Rule will be created or updated. Use BUNNYCDN_GET_PULL_ZONE_LIST to get valid IDs.

ActionParameter1.description: First action parameter. Meaning depends on ActionType: for redirect = destination URL, for set_response_header = header name, for override_cache_time = TTL in seconds, for set_status_code = status code (e.g., '404').

ActionParameter2.description: Second action parameter. Meaning depends on ActionType: for redirect = redirect type ('301' or '302'), for set_response_header = header value.

ActionParameter3.description: Third action parameter. Meaning depends on ActionType. Rarely used, reserved for future action types.

dnszones.checkAvailability.title: Check DNS Zone Availability
dnszones.checkAvailability.description: Tool to check if a DNS zone name is available for registration. Use before creating a new DNS zone to verify the domain name is not already in use.

Name.description: The domain name to check for DNS zone availability (e.g., 'example.com').

pullzones.checkAvailability.title: Check Pull Zone Availability
pullzones.checkAvailability.description: Tool to check if a pull zone name is available for registration. Use before creating a new pull zone to verify the name is not already in use.

Name.description: The pull zone name to check for availability. This will be used as the subdomain (e.g., 'my-zone' becomes 'my-zone.b-cdn.net').

storagezones.checkAvailability.title: Check Storage Zone Availability
storagezones.checkAvailability.description: Tool to check if a storage zone name is available. Use before creating a new storage zone to verify the name is not already in use.

Name.description: The storage zone name to check for availability. Must be unique and can contain alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

billing.coinify.create.title: Create Coinify Payment
billing.coinify.create.description: Tool to create a Coinify cryptocurrency payment for BunnyCDN billing. Use when you need to add credit to a BunnyCDN account using cryptocurrency. Note: This endpoint is deprecated. Consider using alternative payment methods if available.

amount.description: The amount to charge in USD. Must be a positive number (e.g., 10.00, 50.25).

paymentRequestId.description: Optional payment request ID to associate with this payment. Use this to track or link the payment to an existing request.

databases.create.title: Create Database
databases.create.description: Creates a new Bunny Database (SQLite-compatible edge database). The database can be deployed in multiple global edge regions with primary and replica configurations for high availability. Storage is available in EU (eu-west-1) or North America (us-east-1), and can be deployed across 41 global edge regions. Use when you need a distributed edge database with SQLite compatibility.

name.description: The name of the database to create. Must be unique within your account.

primary_regions.description: Array of primary region codes where the database will be deployed. Valid region codes include: AMS, ASB, AT, BE, BO, BR, BU, CA, CO, CZ, DE, DEN, DK, ES, FR, GA, GR, HK, HR, ID, IL, ISR, IT, JH, JP, LA, MI, MX, MY, NG, NY, PH, PL, SE, SG, SIL, SYD, TH, TR, TX, UK, WA.

replicas_regions.description: Array of replica region codes for read replicas. Can be an empty array if no replicas are needed. Uses same region codes as primary_regions.

dnszones.records.create.title: Create DNS Record
dnszones.records.create.description: Tool to create a new DNS record in a specific DNS zone. Use after confirming the DNS zone ID is active.

Ttl.description: Time to live for the record in seconds.

Value.description: The value of the record (e.g., IP for A record).

Weight.description: Weight of the record (e.g., for SRV records).

zone_id.description: The DNS Zone ID to which the record will be added.

ScriptId.description: Script ID for Script record type.

PullZoneId.description: Pull Zone ID for PullZone record type.

EnviromentalVariables.description: List of environment variable objects for the record.

databases.groups.live.title: Create Live Live 2
databases.groups.live.description: Tool to retrieve live metrics data for database groups. Use when you need to fetch current performance metrics for specific group IDs.

group_ids.description: Array of Database Group IDs. Each ID must be a string starting with 'group_' followed by a 26-character ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier). Example: group_01HQWXYZ9ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRST

pullzones.create.title: Create Pull Zone
pullzones.create.description: Creates a new CDN pull zone in BunnyCDN for content delivery acceleration. A pull zone acts as a CDN endpoint that caches and delivers content from your origin server through BunnyCDN's global edge network. When created, you get a default hostname (e.g., 'your-name.b-cdn.net') that can serve your content immediately. Use cases: - Accelerate website asset delivery (images, CSS, JS) - Stream video c

Name.description: Name of the pull zone. This will be used to generate the default CDN hostname (e.g., 'my-pull-zone' becomes 'my-pull-zone.b-cdn.net'). Must be unique across all BunnyCDN users.

Type.description: Type of pull zone. 0 = Standard (Premium) pull zone with global edge locations, 1 = Volume pull zone optimized for high bandwidth workloads. Defaults to 0 (Standard).

OriginUrl.description: The origin server URL from which BunnyCDN will fetch and cache content. Must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL pointing to your source server.

EnableTLS1.description: Enable TLS 1.0 protocol support. Not recommended for security reasons; only enable for legacy client compatibility.

PricingTier.description: Pricing tier for the pull zone. 0 = Standard tier with all regions, 1 = High Volume tier with reduced pricing but fewer edge locations.

AWSSigningKey.description: AWS Access Key ID for S3 authentication. Required if aws_signing_enabled is true.

AddHostHeader.description: Pass the original Host header to the origin server. Enable if your origin requires the Host header for routing or virtual hosting.

EnableLogging.description: Enable access logging for the pull zone. When enabled, request logs are recorded and available for analysis. Default is true.

StorageZoneId.description: ID of a BunnyCDN storage zone to use as the origin instead of an external URL. When set, the pull zone will serve files from the linked storage zone.

EnableWebpVary.description: Enable automatic WebP image optimization. When enabled, images will be converted to WebP format for browsers that support it, reducing file sizes by 25-35%.

EnableGeoZoneAF.description: Enable content delivery from African edge locations. Enabled by default.

EnableGeoZoneAN.description: Enable content delivery from Antarctica edge locations. Rarely needed optional region.

EnableGeoZoneEU.description: Enable content delivery from European edge locations. Enabled by default.

EnableGeoZoneME.description: Enable content delivery from Middle East edge locations. Optional additional region.

EnableGeoZoneOC.description: Enable content delivery from Oceania/Australia edge locations. Optional additional region.

EnableGeoZoneSA.description: Enable content delivery from South American edge locations. Enabled by default.

EnableGeoZoneUS.description: Enable content delivery from US/North America edge locations. Enabled by default.

AWSSigningSecret.description: AWS Secret Access Key for S3 authentication. Required if aws_signing_enabled is true.

EnableCacheSlice.description: Enable cache slicing for large file downloads. When enabled, large files are split into 1MB chunks allowing parallel downloads and faster delivery. Recommended for video/large file delivery.

AWSSigningEnabled.description: Enable AWS Signature V4 authentication for S3-compatible origins. Required when pulling from private S3 buckets or S3-compatible storage.

EnableGeoZoneASIA.description: Enable content delivery from Asia/Pacific edge locations. Enabled by default.

LogForwardingPort.description: Port number of the syslog server for log forwarding. Common ports: 514 (UDP), 6514 (TCP/TLS). Required if log_forwarding_enabled is true.

AddCanonicalHeader.description: Add Link header with canonical URL to responses. Helps search engines understand the canonical version of cached content.

EnableHostnameVary.description: Cache content separately for each hostname. Enable if different hostnames serve different content on the same pull zone.

EnableOriginShield.description: Enable Origin Shield to reduce origin load. All edge requests pass through a shield POP first, improving cache hit ratio and reducing origin requests by up to 70%.

IgnoreQueryStrings.description: When enabled, query string parameters are ignored when caching. Useful when query strings don't affect content (e.g., tracking parameters). Default is true.

LogForwardingToken.description: Authentication token for log forwarding to services that require it (e.g., Datadog API key, Splunk HEC token).

AWSSigningRegionName.description: AWS region name for S3 authentication (e.g., 'us-east-1', 'eu-west-1'). Required if aws_signing_enabled is true.

LogForwardingEnabled.description: Enable real-time log forwarding to an external syslog server. Useful for integrating with log aggregation tools like Splunk, Datadog, or ELK.

LoggingSaveToStorage.description: Save access logs to a BunnyCDN storage zone for long-term storage and analysis. Requires logging_storage_zone_id to be set.

LoggingStorageZoneId.description: ID of the storage zone where access logs will be saved. Required if logging_save_to_storage is true.

OriginShieldZoneCode.description: Two-letter zone code for the origin shield location. Should be closest to your origin server. Common codes: FR (Frankfurt), NY (New York), SG (Singapore), LA (Los Angeles).

EnableCountryCodeVary.description: Cache content separately for each country. Enable if content varies by visitor's geographic location (e.g., geo-targeted content).

LogForwardingHostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the syslog server for log forwarding. Required if log_forwarding_enabled is true.

CacheControlMaxAgeOverride.description: Override the Cache-Control max-age header value in seconds. Use -1 to respect origin headers, 0 for no caching, or a positive value for specific TTL. Common values: 3600 (1 hour), 86400 (1 day).

shield.rateLimits.create.title: Create Shield Rate Limit
shield.rateLimits.create.description: Tool to create a new Shield rate limit rule for protecting against excessive requests. Use when you need to configure rate limiting rules to prevent abuse, DDoS attacks, or API overuse on a Shield zone.

shieldZoneId.description: ID of the Shield zone where the rate limit rule will be applied.

ruleDescription.description: Description of the rate limit rule's purpose.

ruleConfiguration.description: Configuration object defining the rate limit rule behavior.

shield.accessLists.create.description: Tool to create a new custom access list in a Shield Zone. Use when you need to add IP addresses, countries, ASNs, or JA3 fingerprints to control access.

description.description: Optional description of the access list's purpose or contents.

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to which the Custom Access List will be associated.

mc.registries.configSuggestions.title: Get Container Config Suggestions
mc.registries.configSuggestions.description: Tool to get AI-powered configuration suggestions for deploying a container image on BunnyCDN's Magic Containers platform. mc.registries.digest.description: Tool to retrieve the digest of a container image from a registry. Use when you need to verify an image version or pin to a specific digest.

imageName.description: Container image name to query for the digest.

registryId.description: Registry identifier (e.g., 'dockerhub', 'github', or a private registry ID).

imageNamespace.description: Image namespace (e.g., 'library' for official Docker Hub images, or an organization/user name).

databases.get.title: Get Database
databases.get.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific database by its ID. Use when you need database configuration, size information, and region settings.

db_id.description: Database ID with 'db_' prefix (e.g., db_01KHB7B3RQ1SP3KT6KRYHCAMRH). Use BUNNYCDN_LIST_DATABASES to get valid database IDs.

databases.statistics.description: Tool to retrieve time-series statistics for a Bunny Database instance. dnszones.get.title: Get DNS Zone Details
dnszones.get.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific DNS zone by its ID. Use when you need to verify DNS zone configuration after creation or update.

id.description: Unique identifier of the DNS zone to retrieve. Obtain this from the Get DNS Zone List action.

dnszones.list.title: Get DNS Zone List
dnszones.list.description: Tool to list all DNS zones in your Bunny CDN account. Use when you need an overview of all configured DNS zones.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

perPage.description: Number of DNS zones to return per page (1-1000).

databases.groups.get.title: Get Database Group
databases.groups.get.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific database group by its ID. Use when you need to get configuration and region information for a database group.

group_id.description: The ID of the database group to retrieve. Must be a ULID format starting with 'group_' followed by 26 alphanumeric characters (e.g., group_01KHB780B9MB0QJTFAQ0M6QCYK)

stream.oembed.title: Get oEmbed
stream.oembed.description: Tool to retrieve oEmbed metadata for BunnyCDN video embeds. Use when you need embed code or video metadata in oEmbed format.

token.description: Security token for accessing the video, if token authentication is enabled.

expires.description: Token expiration timestamp (Unix timestamp in seconds).

maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the embedded video player in pixels.

maxHeight.description: Maximum height of the embedded video player in pixels.

mc.regions.optimal.title: Get Optimal Base Region
mc.regions.optimal.description: Tool to get the optimal base region for Magic Containers. Use when you need to determine the best region for deploying Magic Container instances based on current capacity and network conditions.

cdnServerToken.description: Optional CDN server token parameter for determining the optimal region. If not provided, the API will use default logic to determine the optimal region.

pullzones.optimizer.statistics.title: Get Optimizer Statistics
pullzones.optimizer.statistics.description: Retrieve optimizer statistics for a Pull Zone to understand optimization performance. Use this action to analyze how Bunny Optimizer is performing for a specific Pull Zone, including compression ratios, processing times, optimized request counts, and traffic savings. Supports custom date ranges and hourly/daily grouping for detailed analysis.

dateTo.description: The end date of the statistics in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). If not provided, the last 30 days will be returned.

hourly.description: If true, the statistics data will be returned in hourly grouping. If false or omitted, daily grouping is used.

pullZoneId.description: The ID of the Pull Zone to retrieve optimizer statistics for. Use BUNNYCDN_GET_PULL_ZONE_LIST to get valid IDs.

pullzones.originShield.queueStatistics.title: Get Origin Shield Queue Statistics
pullzones.originShield.queueStatistics.description: Tool to retrieve Origin Shield Queue Statistics for a specific Pull Zone. Use when you need to analyze Origin Shield performance metrics including concurrent and queued request data over a specified time period.

dateTo.description: The end date of the statistics in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-31'). If not provided, the last 30 days will be returned.

hourly.description: If true, the statistics data will be returned in hourly grouping instead of daily. Defaults to false.

dateFrom.description: The start date of the statistics in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01'). If not provided, the last 30 days will be returned.

pullZoneId.description: Unique identifier of the Pull Zone to retrieve Origin Shield statistics for. Use BUNNYCDN_GET_PULL_ZONE_LIST to get valid IDs.

pullzones.safehop.statistics.title: Get SafeHop Statistics
pullzones.safehop.statistics.description: Tool to retrieve SafeHop statistics for a specific Pull Zone. dateTo.description: The end date of the statistics in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-31'). If not provided, statistics for the last 30 days will be returned.

hourly.description: If true, the statistics data will be returned in hourly grouping. If false or not provided, daily grouping is used.

dateFrom.description: The start date of the statistics in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01'). If not provided, statistics for the last 30 days will be returned.

pullZoneId.description: The ID of the Pull Zone to retrieve SafeHop statistics for. Use BUNNYCDN_GET_PULL_ZONE_LIST to get valid Pull Zone IDs.

shield.botDetection.get.title: Get Shield Bot Detection Configuration

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to retrieve bot detection configuration for.

shield.eventLogs.get.title: Get Shield Event Logs
shield.eventLogs.get.description: Tool to retrieve Shield Event Logs for a specific Shield Zone and date. Use when you need to view security events and Shield activity logs. Supports pagination via continuation tokens for large log sets.

date.description: The Date (MM-dd-yyyy) of returned Event Logs. Format: MM-dd-yyyy (e.g., '02-13-2026').

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to retrieve event logs for.

shield.metrics.botDetection.title: Get Shield Metrics Bot Detection

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to retrieve bot detection metrics for.

shield.metrics.overview.title: Get Shield Metrics Overview

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to retrieve metrics for.

shield.metrics.overviewDetailed.title: Get Shield Metrics Overview Detailed
shield.metrics.overviewDetailed.description: Tool to retrieve detailed Shield zone metrics overview including DDoS protection, WAF, bot detection, rate limiting, access lists, and upload scanning statistics. shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to retrieve metrics for.

shield_zone_id.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to retrieve rate limit metrics for.

shield.metrics.uploadScanning.title: Get Shield Metrics Upload Scanning

perPage.description: The amount of results returned on one page. Defaults to 10 if not specified.

shield.zones.list.title: Get Shield Shield Zones
shield.zones.list.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all Shield Zones with their configurations. Use when you need to view all Shield Zones and their security settings. Supports pagination to handle large numbers of Shield Zones.

perPage.description: The amount of results returned on one page.

shield.uploadScanning.get.title: Get Shield Upload Scanning Configuration
shield.uploadScanning.get.description: Tool to retrieve upload scanning configuration for a Shield Zone. Use when you need to check antivirus and CSAM scanning settings for uploaded files.

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to retrieve upload scanning configuration for.

shield.waf.customRules.get.title: Get Shield WAF Custom Rule by ID

serverZoneId.description: If set, the statistics will be only returned for the given region ID.

imageNamespace.description: Image namespace (e.g., 'library' for official Docker Hub images, or an organization/user name).

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1

databases.usage.description: Tool to retrieve aggregated usage metrics for a Bunny Database instance. Returns total rows read/written and average latency for a specified date range. Use when you need aggregated usage statistics rather than time-series data.

compute.scripts.list.title: List Edge Scripts
compute.scripts.list.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all edge scripts in your BunnyCDN account. Use when you need to discover existing edge scripts, their IDs, types, and configuration.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1. Omit to use API default (1).

type.description: Filter by edge script type. Provide a list of type IDs to filter results.

search.description: Search term to filter edge scripts by name. Leave empty to return all scripts.

perPage.description: Number of results per page (1-1000). Omit to use API default (1000).

integrationId.description: Filter by linked integration ID. Omit to return scripts from all integrations.

includeLinkedPullzones.description: Whether to include linked pull zones in the response. Omit for API default (false).

databases.groups.statistics.title: List Group Statistics
databases.groups.statistics.description: Tool to retrieve time-series statistics for a database group. Returns data for row read/write counts and storage usage over a specified date range. Use when you need to analyze group-level performance, usage patterns, or billing data.

to.description: End date/time in ISO 8601 format for the statistics range (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z). Must be after 'from' parameter.

from.description: Start date/time in ISO 8601 format for the statistics range (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z). Must be before 'to' parameter.

group_id.description: The ID of the database group to retrieve statistics for. Must be a ULID format starting with 'group_' followed by 26 alphanumeric characters (e.g., group_01KHB780B9MB0QJTFAQ0M6QCYK)

databases.groups.usage.title: List Database Group Usage
databases.groups.usage.description: Tool to retrieve aggregated usage statistics for a database group over a specified time period. Returns total rows read/written and average latency. Use when you need to analyze group-level usage patterns or billing data.

to.description: End date/time in ISO 8601 format for the usage aggregation period (e.g., 2026-02-13T23:59:59Z). Must be after 'from' parameter.

from.description: Start date/time in ISO 8601 format for the usage aggregation period (e.g., 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z). Must be before 'to' parameter.

group_id.description: The ID of the database group to retrieve usage for. Must be a ULID format starting with 'group_' followed by 26 alphanumeric characters (e.g., group_01KHB780B9MB0QJTFAQ0M6QCYK)

mc.nodes.list.title: List Nodes
mc.nodes.list.description: Tool to retrieve a list of Magic Container nodes in your BunnyCDN account. Use when you need to view available node IP addresses for Magic Containers. Supports pagination through cursor-based navigation.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page (1-1000). Default is 20 if not specified.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page of results.

mc.regions.list.title: List Regions
mc.regions.list.description: Tool to list all available regions for Magic Containers. Use when you need to discover available deployment regions, check their capacity status, or understand Anycast support across regions.

limit.description: Number of regions to return per page (1-1000). Default is 20 if not specified.

nextCursor.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results. Omit for the first page.

videolibraries.list.title: List Video Libraries
videolibraries.list.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all video libraries in your BunnyCDN account. Use when you need to discover existing video libraries, their IDs, and configuration details.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (0-indexed). Default is 0.

search.description: Search term to filter video libraries by name. Leave empty to return all video libraries.

perPage.description: Number of results per page (1-1000). Default is 1000.

mc.volumes.list.title: List Volumes
mc.volumes.list.description: Tool to list all volumes for a Magic Container application in your BunnyCDN account. Use when you need to view storage volumes, their capacity, usage, and attached instances for a specific app.

appId.description: Application identifier for which to list volumes

limit.description: Number of items to return per page (1-1000). Default is 20 if not specified.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page of results.

shield.waf.rules.reviewTriggered.apply.title: Post Shield WAF Rules Review Triggered
shield.waf.rules.reviewTriggered.apply.description: Tool to review and apply actions to triggered WAF rules in a specific Shield Zone. Use when you need to whitelist, block, or challenge specific WAF rules based on their triggered status.

ruleId.description: The ID of the specific WAF rule to apply the action to. This field is required by the API.

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone for the Triggered Rule.

purge.url.title: Purge URL
purge.url.description: Purge a specific URL from the BunnyCDN cache to force it to be refreshed from the origin. Use this tool when you need to: - Invalidate cached content after updating a file on the origin server - Force immediate cache refresh for a specific resource - Clear outdated content from edge servers Note: The URL must belong to a pull zone you have access to. Attempting to purge URLs from pull zones you do

url.description: The full URL of the cached content to purge. Must include the complete URL with protocol (https://) and the BunnyCDN pull zone hostname (e.g., your-zone.b-cdn.net). The URL must belong to a pull zone you own.

async_flag.description: If true, the purge request returns immediately without waiting for completion (non-blocking). If false (default), waits for the purge to complete before returning.

pullzones.removeAllowedReferer.title: Remove Allowed Referer
pullzones.removeAllowedReferer.description: Removes a hostname from the allowed referer list for a pull zone. Use this action to remove a previously configured referer-based security restriction. After removal, the specified hostname will no longer be allowed to access the pull zone content. This is useful when updating referer security policies or removing domains that should no longer have access.

id.description: The ID of the pull zone from which the allowed referer will be removed. Use the 'Get Pull Zone List' action to find available pull zone IDs.

Hostname.description: The hostname that will be removed from the allowed referer list. This must match an existing allowed referer exactly (e.g., 'example.com', 'www.mysite.com').

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

pullzones.removeBlockedIp.title: Remove Blocked IP
pullzones.removeBlockedIp.description: Tool to remove an IP address from the blocked list of a pull zone. Use when you need to restore access for specific IPs that were previously blocked.

id.description: The ID of the Pull Zone from which the IP will be unblocked. Use BUNNYCDN_GET_PULL_ZONE_LIST to get valid IDs.

BlockedIp.description: The IP address that will be removed from the blocked list. Supports IPv4 and IPv6 formats.

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

pullzones.removeBlockedReferer.title: Remove Blocked Referer
pullzones.removeBlockedReferer.description: Tool to remove a blocked referer from a pull zone. Use when you need to allow a previously blocked domain to access content from your CDN again.

id.description: The ID of the pull zone from which the blocked referer will be removed. Use the 'Get Pull Zone List' action to find available pull zone IDs.

Hostname.description: The hostname that will be removed from the blocked referer list. After removal, requests with this referer will no longer be blocked.

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

pullzones.resetSecurityKey.title: Reset Pull Zone Security Key
pullzones.resetSecurityKey.description: Tool to reset the security token key for a specific pull zone. Use when you need to regenerate the security key for authentication purposes.

id.description: The ID of the requested Pull Zone whose security key should be reset.

SecurityKey.description: Optional custom security key to set. If not provided, a random key will be generated. Must be between 8 and 36 characters.

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.
True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

databases.restore.title: Restore Database
databases.restore.description: Tool to restore a BunnyCDN database to a specific generation/version. This is a destructive operation that will revert the database to the specified point in time. Use when you need to recover data from a previous version or undo unwanted changes. WARNING: This operation is destructive and will overwrite current database state.

db_id.description: The unique database identifier (starts with 'db_'). Use BUNNYCDN_LIST_DATABASES to get valid database IDs.

generation.description: The UUID of the generation/version to restore to (32-character hexadecimal UUID format without dashes, e.g., '00000000000000000000000000000001'). This is a destructive operation that will restore the database to this specific point in time.

search.global.title: Search Global Search
search.global.description: Perform a global search across all BunnyCDN resources (pull zones, storage zones, DNS zones, scripts, streams). Use this to discover resources by name across your entire BunnyCDN account. Supports pagination with 'from' and 'size' parameters. Returns matching resources with their type, ID, and name for easy identification.

from.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default is 0.

size.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 20.

search.description: The search query term to find resources by name. Leave empty to return all resources.

mc.registries.publicImages.search.title: Search Public Container Images
mc.registries.publicImages.search.description: Tool to search for public container images by prefix in a registry. Use when you need to discover available public container images matching a search term.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

size.description: Results per page. Defaults to API default if not specified.

prefix.description: Search term for image discovery. Returns images whose names match this prefix.

registryId.description: Registry identifier - accepts 'dockerhub', 'github', or private registry IDs.

pullzones.edgeRules.setEnabled.title: Set Edge Rule Enabled
pullzones.edgeRules.setEnabled.description: Tool to enable or disable an edge rule in a BunnyCDN pull zone. Use when you need to activate or deactivate an existing edge rule without modifying its configuration. Edge rules that are disabled remain configured but do not execute. This allows you to temporarily turn off rules without deleting them. Common use cases: temporarily disable security rules for testing, enable/disable seasonal redirec

enabled.description: Set to true to enable the edge rule, false to disable it. Disabled rules remain configured but do not execute.

edge_rule_id.description: The ID of the Edge Rule that should be updated. This is a UUID (GUID) identifier returned when creating an edge rule.

pull_zone_id.description: The ID of the Pull Zone that contains the Edge Rule. Use BUNNYCDN_GET_PULL_ZONE_LIST to get valid IDs.

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

pullzones.setForceSSL.title: Set Force SSL
pullzones.setForceSSL.description: Tool to set Force SSL on a pull zone hostname. Use when you need to enable or disable HTTPS enforcement for a specific hostname.

id.description: The ID of the requested Pull Zone. Use the 'Get Pull Zone List' action to find available pull zone IDs.

ForceSSL.description: Set to true to force SSL on the given pull zone hostname. When enabled, all HTTP requests will be redirected to HTTPS.

Hostname.description: The hostname that will be updated. This should be one of the hostnames associated with the pull zone (e.g., 'test-pull-zone-minimal-001.b-cdn.net').

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.
True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

databases.update.title: Update Database
databases.update.description: Tool to update an existing Bunny Database. Use when you need to change database name or control read/write access.

db_id.description: Database ID with 'db_' prefix (e.g., db_01KHB7B3RQ1SP3KT6KRYHCAMRH). Use BUNNYCDN_LIST_DATABASES or BUNNYCDN_GET_DATABASE to get valid database IDs.

block_reads.description: Whether to block read operations on the database

block_writes.description: Whether to block write operations on the database

databases.groups.update.title: Update Database Group
databases.groups.update.description: Tool to update a database group by its ID. Use when you need to modify the name or configuration of a database group.

name.description: Updated name for the database group

group_id.description: The ID of the database group to update. Must be a ULID format starting with 'group_' followed by 26 alphanumeric characters (e.g., group_01KHB7B3JHCANBBAWPTXSEZH1H)

pullzones.update.title: Update Pull Zone
pullzones.update.description: Tool to update settings for a specific pull zone. Use when you need to modify existing pull zone settings after reviewing current configuration.

id.description: ID of the pull zone to update

Name.description: New name for the pull zone.

Type.description: Type of pull zone. 0 for standard pull zone.

OriginUrl.description: New origin server URL from which BunnyCDN will pull content.

PricingTier.description: Pricing tier for the pull zone. 0=Standard, 1=High Volume.

StorageZoneId.description: ID of the storage zone to link, if applicable.

BlockedCountries.description: List of country codes from which traffic is blocked.

LogForwardingPort.description: Port to which logs are forwarded.

LogForwardingToken.description: Token used for log forwarding authentication.

LoggingStorageZoneId.description: ID of the storage zone where logs are saved.

LogForwardingHostname.description: Hostname to which logs are forwarded.

BudgetRedirectedCountries.description: List of country codes to which traffic is redirected for budget reasons.

CacheControlMaxAgeOverride.description: Override the max-age directive in the Cache-Control header.

shield.botDetection.update.title: Update Shield Bot Detection Configuration
shield.botDetection.update.description: Tool to update bot detection configuration for a specific Shield Zone. Use when you need to modify bot detection settings, sensitivity levels, or execution mode. Note: Bot detection requires Advanced tier subscription.

ipAddress.description: IP address configuration for bot detection.

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to update bot detection configuration for.

requestIntegrity.description: Request integrity configuration for bot detection.

browserFingerprint.description: Browser fingerprint configuration for bot detection.

shield.rateLimits.update.title: Update Shield Rate Limit by ID
shield.rateLimits.update.description: Tool to update a specific rate limit configuration by its ID. Use when you need to modify settings of an existing shield rate limit rule such as request thresholds, timeframes, or action types.

id.description: The ID of the Rate Limit to update.

ruleName.description: Name of the rate limit rule.

ruleDescription.description: Human-readable description of the rate limit rule.

ruleConfiguration.description: Configuration details for the rate limit rule.

shield.zones.update.title: Update Shield Zone
shield.zones.update.description: Tool to update configuration settings for a Shield Zone. Use when you need to modify DDoS protection settings, WAF rules, or security configurations.

shieldZone.description: Shield Zone configuration settings to update. Only include the fields you want to modify.

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to update.

shield.accessLists.update.title: Update Shield Zone Access List
shield.accessLists.update.description: Tool to update a custom access list in a Shield Zone. Use when you need to modify an access control rule's name, content, or checksum.

id.description: The ID of the Custom Access List to update.

name.description: The new display name for the access list. If null, the current name is preserved.

content.description: The new content for the access list with entries separated by newlines. If null, the current content is preserved.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the new content for integrity verification. If null, it will be automatically calculated.

shieldZoneId.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to which the Custom Access List belongs.

shield.accessLists.updateConfiguration.title: Update Shield Zone Access List Configuration
shield.accessLists.updateConfiguration.description: Tool to update an access list configuration in a Shield Zone. Use when you need to modify the action or enabled state of an existing access list configuration.

id.description: The ID of the Access List Configuration to update.

is_enabled.description: Whether the access list should be enabled or disabled. If null, the current state is preserved.

shield_zone_id.description: The ID of the Shield Zone to which the Access List Configuration belongs.

shield.uploadScanning.update.title: Update Shield Zone Upload Scanning
shield.uploadScanning.update.description: Tool to update upload scanning settings for a shield zone. Use when you need to configure antivirus and CSAM scanning for uploaded files.

is_enabled.description: Enable or disable upload scanning. If true, files uploaded to this shield zone will be scanned according to the configured scanning modes.

shield_zone_id.description: Unique identifier of the shield zone to update upload scanning settings for.

storagezones.update.title: Update Storage Zone
storagezones.update.description: Tool to update settings for a specific storage zone. Updates are applied immediately and can destructively alter storage zone configuration. Verify the correct `id` and confirm intended changes before calling.

id.description: Unique identifier of the storage zone to update.

OriginUrl.description: Backup origin URL. When a file is not found in the storage zone, Bunny will attempt to proxy and fetch it from this URL instead. Set to empty string to remove.

Rewrite404To200.description: If true, 404 errors will be returned as 200 OK status codes. Useful for single-page applications where routing is handled client-side.

ReplicationZones.description: List of region codes for data replication. Valid codes: DE (Frankfurt), UK (London), SE (Stockholm), CZ (Prague), ES (Madrid), NY (New York), LA (Los Angeles), WA (Seattle), MI (Miami), SG (Singapore), HK (Hong Kong), JP (Tokyo), SYD (Sydney), BR (Sao Paulo), JH (Johannesburg).

Custom404FilePath.description: Path to a custom 404 error page file within the storage zone. This file will be served when a requested file is not found.

ok.description: True when BunnyCDN acknowledges the request.

user.update.title: Update User Details
user.update.description: Tool to update the currently authorized user's account details. Use when modifying user profile information, billing details, or email preferences.

City.description: Sets the city name of the user's address.

Email.description: Sets the user email. Must be a valid email format.

Country.description: Sets the country of the user's address. Must be a two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

ZipCode.description: Sets the ZIP code of the user's address.

LastName.description: Sets the last name of the account owner.

Password.description: Sets the login password for the user account. OldPassword should also be sent when changing password.

DmcaEmail.description: Sets the abuse email where abuse notifications are sent. Must be a valid email format.

FirstName.description: Sets the first name of the account owner.

VATNumber.description: Sets the VAT number used for the billing details.

CompanyName.description: Sets the company name of the company responsible for the account.

OldPassword.description: The verification password when changing the password through the Password property. Required if Password is provided.

BillingEmail.description: Sets the billing email where the invoices will be sent. Must be a valid email format.

StreetAddress.description: Sets the street name and number of the user's address.

ReceivePromotionalEmails.description: Determines if the account should receive promotional emails from bunny.net.

ReceiveNotificationEmails.description: Determines if the account should receive notification emails from bunny.net.

pullzones.validateOriginUrl.title: Validate Origin URL Pull Zone
pullzones.validateOriginUrl.description: Tool to validate an origin URL before creating or configuring a pull zone. Use when you need to verify that an origin URL is accessible and properly configured for use with BunnyCDN.

OriginUrl.description: The origin URL to validate. Must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL that will be used as the content source for a pull zone.
